big_idea: New Toastmasters members progress faster through the Competent Communicator manual when they can study model speeches and side-by-side analysis for each of the program's core speech projects, rather than guessing how to meet each project's objectives.

tool.label: Speech-project analysis table
tool.text: For each of the ten Competent Communicator projects, the book pairs a full model speech with a table showing exactly how it satisfies that project's stated objectives.
tool.note: Independently published title with no coverage found from major review outlets, Four Minute Books, Shortform, or Blinkist. The only substantive third-party assessment is mixed Goodreads reviews, and the author's stated credentials could not be independently confirmed beyond his own site.

ideas.title: Model speeches per project
ideas.text: Each Competent Communicator project gets an example speech to study rather than an abstract description.

ideas.title: Delivery mechanics broken out separately
ideas.text: Body language, vocal variety, and pacing are treated project by project rather than as one generic lesson.

ideas.title: Topic selection guidance
ideas.text: The book gives a process for picking speech topics, flagged by reviewers as a genuinely useful section.

ideas.title: Eliminating distracting habits
ideas.text: Filler words and nervous mannerisms are addressed as their own topic.

try_it: Before your next club speech, write one sentence stating that project's core objective and check your draft against it.
Record yourself delivering a 2-minute practice speech and count filler words to establish a baseline.
Draft three possible topics for your next talk and pick the one you can make most personal and concrete.
best_for: Brand-new Toastmasters members working through the Competent Communicator manual
less_useful: Anyone outside the Toastmasters program, since the book is built entirely around that specific curriculum
Speakers wanting original theory or research rather than a study companion

related.why: A more rigorously sourced take on the physical and vocal side of stage delivery
A well-verified framework for the impromptu speaking Toastmasters also trains
